title: Hugo / Tools and Connectors
description: Tool calls by connector, effect, decision, and status; tool latency and output size; failures; connector sessions; approvals; and resource health; and a wave 2 row for the infrastructure, observability, HTTP, MCP, and remote agent connectors.

links.title: Logs in Loki
links.tooltip: Open matching log lines in Explore

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Prometheus scrape job of the Hugo server (hugo-server in Docker Compose).

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Agent and tool traffic is bursty, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Tool invocations in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: Allowed tool invocations that did not finish successfully in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect", decision!~"(?i)denied", status!~"(?i)(ok|success|succeeded|completed)"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Denied
panels.description: Invocations the policy engine denied in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect", decision=~"(?i)denied"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Approval required
panels.description: Invocations that needed a human approval in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect", decision=~"(?i)approval_?required"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Tool latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile tool execution time over the averaging window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Sessions open
panels.description: Connector sessions (SSH, database, and so on) open right now.

targets.expr: sum(hugo_connector_sessions_active{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Calls by connector (per minute)
panels.description: Tool invocations per minute by connector.

targets.expr: sum by (connector) (rate(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "connector", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Calls by effect (per minute)
panels.description: Tool invocations per minute by effect (read, write, destructive).

targets.expr: sum by (effect) (rate(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "effect", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Policy decisions
panels.description: Invocations per interval by policy decision (allowed, denied, approval required).

targets.expr: sum by (decision) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "decision", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Calls by status
panels.description: Invocations per interval by final status.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "status", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Calls by surface
panels.description: Invocations per interval by the surface that triggered them (agent turn, MCP, A2A, REST).

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "surface", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tool latency
panels.description: Tool execution time percentiles. Exemplars link to the <connector> <tool> span in Tempo.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Tool latency p95 by connector
panels.description: 95th percentile tool execution time by connector.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, connector) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window])))

panels.title: Output size p95 by connector
panels.description: 95th percentile tool output size (bytes returned to the model, after truncation) by connector.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, connector) (rate(hugo_tool_output_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$window])))

panels.title: Failures by connector and tool
panels.description: Allowed invocations that did not succeed, per interval, by connector and tool.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, tool) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect", decision!~"(?i)denied", status!~"(?i)(ok|success|succeeded|completed)"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tools
panels.description: Every tool called in the selected range: calls, failure share, and latency.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, tool) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__range]))

sum by (connector, tool) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect", status!~"(?i)(ok|success|succeeded|completed)"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (connector, tool) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", effect=~"$effect"}[$__range])), 1)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, connector, tool) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, connector, tool) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Approvals by outcome
panels.description: Approval requests resolved per interval by outcome (approved, rejected, expired, cancelled).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(hugo_approvals_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Approval wait
panels.description: p50 and p95 time an invocation waited for a human decision, by effect.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, effect) (rate(hugo_approval_wait_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", effect=~"$effect"}[$window])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, effect) (rate(hugo_approval_wait_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", effect=~"$effect"}[$window])))

panels.title: Sessions open by connector
panels.description: Connector sessions open by connector.

targets.expr: sum by (connector) (hugo_connector_sessions_active{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "connector", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Resource health
panels.description: Resources per connector and health status, from the resource health checks.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, status) (hugo_resource_health{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "status", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Failed tool spans
panels.description: Tool invocation spans that ended in error.

panels.title: Infrastructure calls by connector and effect (per minute)
panels.description: Tool calls per minute on the infrastructure connectors (redis, aws, kubernetes, docker) by connector and classified effect. Write and Destructive calls here usually mean approvals.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, effect) (rate(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", connector=~"redis|aws|kubernetes|docker", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "connector", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Observability and HTTP latency p95 by connector
panels.description: 95th percentile tool execution time for the prometheus, loki, elasticsearch, and http connectors. Slow queries here are usually wide time ranges or broad selectors.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, connector) (rate(hugo_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", connector=~"prometheus|loki|elasticsearch|http"}[$window])))

panels.title: Remote agent and MCP calls by tool and status
panels.description: Calls through the mcp and a2a-agent connectors (external MCP servers and remote A2A agents) by connector, tool, and execution status.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, tool, status) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", connector=~"mcp|a2a-agent", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Wave 2 policy decisions by connector
panels.description: Policy decisions (Allowed, Denied, ApprovalRequired, and so on) for every wave 2 connector: redis, aws, kubernetes, docker, http, prometheus, loki, elasticsearch, mcp, and a2a-agent.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, decision) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", connector=~"redis|aws|kubernetes|docker|http|prometheus|loki|elasticsearch|mcp|a2a-agent", effect=~"$effect"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "decision", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Wave 2 failures by connector and tool
panels.description: Wave 2 tool calls that were not denied and did not succeed, by connector and tool.

targets.expr: sum by (connector, tool) (increase(hugo_tool_invocations_total{job=~"$job", connector=~"$connector", connector=~"redis|aws|kubernetes|docker|http|prometheus|loki|elasticsearch|mcp|a2a-agent", effect=~"$effect", decision!~"(?i)denied", status!~"(?i)(ok|success|succeeded|completed)"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Document operations by outcome
panels.description: Managed document operations and composition outcomes; no document identifiers are metric labels.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, outcome) (rate(hugo_prompt_document_operations_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Document delivery p95
panels.description: Composition and authorized reference read latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(hugo_prompt_document_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$window])))

panels.title: Document content read bytes
panels.description: Canonical Markdown bytes returned by authorized document reads; document bodies are never metric labels.

targets.expr: sum(rate(hugo_prompt_document_read_bytes_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
